sections.label: Book 15
sections.name: The fire altar: the fifth layer

verses.sa: अग्ने जातान् प्र णुदा नः सपत्नान् प्रत्यजातान् नुद जातवेदः। अधि नो ब्रूहि सुमना अहेडँस्तव स्याम शर्मँस्त्रिवरूथ उद्भौ॥
verses.tr: agne jātān pra ṇudā naḥ sapatnān pratyajātān nuda jātavedaḥ adhi no brūhi sumanā aheḍaṃstava syāma śarmaṃstrivarūtha udbhau
verses.en: Drive our born enemies away, O Agni; drive from us foes unborn, O Jatavedas. Graciously-minded, free from anger, bless us: may we enjoy thy firm thrice-guarding shelter.

verses.sa: सहसा जातान् प्र णुदा नः सपत्नान् प्रत्यजाताञ्जातवेदो नुदस्व। अधि नो ब्रूहि सुमनस्यमानो वयं स्याम प्र णुदा नः सपत्नान्॥
verses.tr: sahasā jātān pra ṇudā naḥ sapatnān pratyajātāñjātavedo nudasva adhi no brūhi sumanasyamāno vayaṃ syāma pra ṇudā naḥ sapatnān
verses.en: Drive off with might our foemen born and living: keep off those yet unborn, O Jatavedas. Benevolent in thought and spirit bless us. May we remain alive: drive off our foemen.

verses.sa: षोडशी स्तोम ओजो द्रविणं चतुश्चत्वारिंश स्तोमो वर्चो द्रविणम्। अग्नेः पुरीषमस्यप्सो नाम तां त्वा विश्वे अभि गृणन्तु देवाः। स्तोमपृष्ठा घृतवतीह सीद प्रजावदस्मे द्रविणा यजस्व॥
verses.tr: ṣoḍaśī stoma ojo draviṇaṃ catuścatvāriṃśa stomo varco draviṇam agneḥ purīṣamasyapso nāma tāṃ tvā viśve abhi gṛṇantu devāḥ stomapṛṣṭhā ghṛtavatīha sīda prajāvadasme draviṇā yajasva
verses.en: The Sixteenfold Soma, strength and wealth. The forty fourth Soma, splendour and wealth. Asas art thou, the complement of Agni. As such may all the Gods greet thee with praises. Enriched with songs of praise, Pf ishthas, and butter, sit here and give us wealth jxrith store of children.

verses.sa: एवश्छन्दो वरिवश्छन्दः शम्भूश्छन्दः परिभूश्छन्द आच्छच्छन्दो मनश्छन्दो व्यचश्छन्दः सिन्धुश्छन्दः समुद्रश्छन्दःसरिरं छन्दः ककुप्छन्दस्त्रिककुप्छन्दः काव्यं छन्दो अङ्कुपं छन्दो ऽक्षरपङ्क्तिश्छन्दः पदपङ्क्तिश्छन्दो विष्टारपङ्क्तिश्छन्दः क्षुरो भ्रजश्छन्दः॥
verses.tr: evaśchando varivaśchandaḥ śambhūśchandaḥ paribhūśchanda ācchacchando manaśchando vyacaśchandaḥ sindhuśchandaḥ samudraśchandaḥsariraṃ chandaḥ kakupchandastrikakupchandaḥ kāvyaṃ chando aṅkupaṃ chando 'kṣarapaṅktiśchandaḥ padapaṅktiśchando viṣṭārapaṅktiśchandaḥ kṣuro bhrajaśchandaḥ
verses.en: Course metre. Space metre. Happy metre. Encompassing metre. Covering metre. Mind metre. Expanse metre. River metre. Sea metre. Water metre. Kakup metre. Kakups metre. Kavya metre. AAkupa metre. Aksha Panktis metre. Prajapati metre. Vishtiapankti metre. KshurabhriLja metre.

verses.sa: आच्छच्छन्दः प्रच्छच्छन्दः संयच्छन्दो वियच्छन्दो बृहच्छन्दो रथन्तरञ्छन्दो निकायश्छन्दो विवधश्छन्दो गिरश्छन्दो भ्रजश्छन्दः संस्तुप्छन्दो ऽनुष्टुप्छन्द एवश्छन्दो वरिवश्छन्दो वयश्छन्दो वयस्कृच्छन्दो विष्पर्धाश्छन्दो विशालं छन्दश्छदिश्छन्दो दूरोहणं छन्दस्तन्द्रं छन्दो अङ्काङ्कं छन्दः॥
verses.tr: ācchacchandaḥ pracchacchandaḥ saṃyacchando viyacchando bṛhacchando rathantarañchando nikāyaśchando vivadhaśchando giraśchando bhrajaśchandaḥ saṃstupchando 'nuṣṭupchanda evaśchando varivaśchando vayaśchando vayaskṛcchando viṣpardhāśchando viśālaṃ chandaśchadiśchando dūrohaṇaṃ chandastandraṃ chando aṅkāṅkaṃ chandaḥ
verses.en: Covering metre. Clothing metre. Collecting metre. Parting metre. Brihat metre. Rathantara metre. Group metre. Vivadhra metre. Swallower metre. Bright metre. Samstup metre. Anushtup metre. Course metre. Space metre. Vigour metre. Vigour-giving metre. Emulating metre. Spacious metre, Inaccessible metre. Slow metre. Aftkanka metre.

verses.sa: रश्मिना सत्याय सत्यं जिन्व प्रेतिना धर्मणा धर्मं जिन्वान्वित्या दिवा दिवं जिन्व सन्धिनाऽन्तरिक्षेणान्तरिक्षं जिन्व प्रतिधिना पृथिव्या पृथिवीं जिन्व विष्टम्भेन वृष्ट्या वृष्टिं जिन्व प्रवयाऽह्नाऽहर्जिन्वानुया रात्र्या रात्रीं जिन्वोशिजा वसुभ्यो वसूञ्जिन्व प्रकेतेनादित्येभ्य आदित्याञ्जिन्व॥
verses.tr: raśminā satyāya satyaṃ jinva pretinā dharmaṇā dharmaṃ jinvānvityā divā divaṃ jinva sandhinā'ntarikṣeṇāntarikṣaṃ jinva pratidhinā pṛthivyā pṛthivīṃ jinva viṣṭambhena vṛṣṭyā vṛṣṭiṃ jinva pravayā'hnā'harjinvānuyā rātryā rātrīṃ jinvośijā vasubhyo vasūñjinva praketenādityebhya ādityāñjinva
verses.en: With the ray for truth quicken thou truth, With advance by duty quicken duty. With following by heaven quicken heaven. With union by middle air quicken middle air. With Pratidhi by Earth quicken Earth. With support by rain quicken rain. With blowing away by day quicken day. With following by night quicken night. With clarified butter by the Vasus quicken the Vasus, With perception by the Adityas quicken the Aditya.

verses.sa: तन्तुना रायस्पोषेण रायस्पोषं जिन्व संसर्पेण श्रुताय श्रुतं जिन्वैडेनौषधीभिरोषधीर्जिन्वोत्तमेन तनूभिस्तनूर्जिन्व वयोधसाधीतेनाधीतं जिन्वाभिजिता तेजसा तेजो जिन्व॥
verses.tr: tantunā rāyaspoṣeṇa rāyaspoṣaṃ jinva saṃsarpeṇa śrutāya śrutaṃ jinvaiḍenauṣadhībhiroṣadhīrjinvottamena tanūbhistanūrjinva vayodhasādhītenādhītaṃ jinvābhijitā tejasā tejo jinva
verses.en: With the thread by prosperity Quicken, prosperity. With the creeper by revelation quicKen revelation. With refreshment by plants quicken plants. With the best by bodies quicken bodies. With the invigorating by religious study quicken i religious study. With the victorious by brilliance quicken brilliance.

verses.sa: प्रतिपदसि प्रतिपदे त्वा ऽनुपदस्यनुपदे त्वा सम्पदसि सम्पदे त्वा तेजोऽसि तेजसे त्वा॥
verses.tr: pratipadasi pratipade tvā 'nupadasyanupade tvā sampadasi sampade tvā tejo'si tejase tvā
verses.en: Thou art Pratipad, for Pratipad thee. Thou art Apupa, for Anupad thee. Thou art Sam pad, for Saramaa thee. Thou art brilliance, for brilliance thee.

verses.sa: त्रिवृदसि त्रिवृते त्वा प्रवृदसि प्रवृते त्वा विवृदसि विवृते त्वा सवृदसि सवृते त्वा ऽऽक्रमोऽस्याक्रमाय त्वा संक्रमोऽसि संक्रमाय त्वोत्क्रमोऽस्युत्क्रमाय त्वोत्क्रान्तिरस्युत्क्रान्त्यै त्वा ऽधिपतिनोर्जोर्जं जिन्व॥
verses.tr: trivṛdasi trivṛte tvā pravṛdasi pravṛte tvā vivṛdasi vivṛte tvā savṛdasi savṛte tvā ''kramo'syākramāya tvā saṃkramo'si saṃkramāya tvotkramo'syutkramāya tvotkrāntirasyutkrāntyai tvā 'dhipatinorjorjaṃ jinva
verses.en: Trivrit (triple) art thou, thee for Trivrit. Pravrit art< thou, thee for Pray it it art thou, thee for Vivrit. Savrit art thou, thee for Savpt. Thou art attack, thee for attack. Thou art concurrence, thee for concurrence. Thou art ascent, thee for ascent. Thou art upstriding, thee for upstriding, With Energy as over-lorda quicken food-essence.

verses.sa: राज्ञ्यसि प्राची दिग्वसवस्ते देवा अधिपतयोऽग्निर्हेतीनां प्रतिधर्ता त्रिवृत् त्वा स्तोमः पृथिव्यां श्रयत्वाज्यमुक्थमव्यथायै स्तभ्नातु रथन्तरं साम प्रतिष्ठित्या अन्तरिक्ष ऋषयस्त्वा प्रथमजा देवेषु दिवो मात्रया वरिम्णा प्रथन्तु विधर्ता चायमधिपतिश्च ते त्वा सर्वे संविदाना नाकस्य पृष्ठे स्वर्गे लोके यजमानं च सादयन्तु॥
verses.tr: rājñyasi prācī digvasavaste devā adhipatayo'gnirhetīnāṃ pratidhartā trivṛt tvā stomaḥ pṛthivyāṃ śrayatvājyamukthamavyathāyai stabhnātu rathantaraṃ sāma pratiṣṭhityā antarikṣa ṛṣayastvā prathamajā deveṣu divo mātrayā varimṇā prathantu vidhartā cāyamadhipatiśca te tvā sarve saṃvidānā nākasya pṛṣṭhe svarge loke yajamānaṃ ca sādayantu
verses.en: Thou art the Queen, the Eastern region. The bright Vasus are thine over-lords. Agni is thy warder-off of hostile weapons. May the Trivrit Soma assist thee on earth. The Ajya Uktha fix 6; thee firmly against slipping. The Rathantara SIman establish thee in the sky for secure station. May the first-born Rishis extend thee among the Gods by the measure and amplitude, of heaven. May this Disposer and the Over-Lord extend thee. May all, concordant, settle thee on the ridge of heaven in the world of Svarga.

verses.sa: विराडसि दक्षिणा दिग्रुद्रास्ते देवा अधिपतय इन्द्रो हेतीनां प्रतिधर्ता पञ्चदस्त्वा स्तोमः पृथिव्यांश्रयतु प्र उगमुक्थमव्यथायै स्तभ्नातु बृहत्साम प्रतिष्ठित्या अन्तरिक्ष ऋषयस्त्वा प्रथमजा देवेषु दिवो मात्रया वरिम्णा प्रथन्तु विधर्ता चायमधिपतिश्च ते त्वा सर्वे संविदाना नाकस्य पृष्ठे स्वर्गे लोके यजमानं च सादयन्तु॥
verses.tr: virāḍasi dakṣiṇā digrudrāste devā adhipataya indro hetīnāṃ pratidhartā pañcadastvā stomaḥ pṛthivyāṃśrayatu pra ugamukthamavyathāyai stabhnātu bṛhatsāma pratiṣṭhityā antarikṣa ṛṣayastvā prathamajā deveṣu divo mātrayā varimṇā prathantu vidhartā cāyamadhipatiśca te tvā sarve saṃvidānā nākasya pṛṣṭhe svarge loke yajamānaṃ ca sādayantu
verses.en: Thou art Far-ruling, the Southern region. The bright Rudras are thine over-lord. Indra is thy warder-off of arrows. May the Panchadasa Soma support thee on earth. The Prauga Uktha fix thee firmly against slipping. The Brihat SiLman establish thee in the sky, etc. the rest as in

verses.sa: सम्राडसि प्रतीची दिगादित्यास्ते देवा अधिपतयो वरुणो हेतीनां प्रतिधर्ता सप्तदशस्त्वा स्तोमः पृथिव्यां श्रयतु मरुत्वतीयमुक्थमव्यथायै स्तभ्नातु वैरूपंसाम प्रतिष्ठित्या अन्तरिक्ष ऋषयस्त्वा प्रथमजा देवेषु दिवो मात्रया वरिम्णा प्रथन्तु विधर्ता चायमधिपतिश्च ते त्वा सर्वे संविदाना नाकस्य पृष्ठे स्वर्गे लोके यजमानं च सादयन्तु॥
verses.tr: samrāḍasi pratīcī digādityāste devā adhipatayo varuṇo hetīnāṃ pratidhartā saptadaśastvā stomaḥ pṛthivyāṃ śrayatu marutvatīyamukthamavyathāyai stabhnātu vairūpaṃsāma pratiṣṭhityā antarikṣa ṛṣayastvā prathamajā deveṣu divo mātrayā varimṇā prathantu vidhartā cāyamadhipatiśca te tvā sarve saṃvidānā nākasya pṛṣṭhe svarge loke yajamānaṃ ca sādayantu
verses.en: Thou art Universal Ruler, the Western region. The Adityas are thine over-lords. Varuna is thy warder-off of missiles. The Saptadasa Soma support thee on earth. The Marutvatiya Uktha fix thee firmly against slipping. The Vairupa Saman establish thee, etc. as above.

verses.sa: स्वराडस्युदीची दिङ्मरुतस्ते देवा अधिपतयः सोमो हेतीनां प्रतिधर्तैकविंशस्त्वा स्तोमः पृथिव्यां श्रयतु निष्केवल्यमुक्थमव्यथायै स्तभ्नातु वैराजँ साम प्रतिष्ठित्या अन्तरिक्ष ऋषयस्त्वा प्रथमजा देवेषु दिवो मात्रया वरिम्णा प्रथन्तु विधर्ता चायमधिपतिश्च ते त्वा सर्वे संविदाना नाकस्य पृष्ठे स्वर्गे लोके यजमानं च सादयन्तु॥
verses.tr: svarāḍasyudīcī diṅmarutaste devā adhipatayaḥ somo hetīnāṃ pratidhartaikaviṃśastvā stomaḥ pṛthivyāṃ śrayatu niṣkevalyamukthamavyathāyai stabhnātu vairājaṃ sāma pratiṣṭhityā antarikṣa ṛṣayastvā prathamajā deveṣu divo mātrayā varimṇā prathantu vidhartā cāyamadhipatiśca te tvā sarve saṃvidānā nākasya pṛṣṭhe svarge loke yajamānaṃ ca sādayantu
verses.en: Thou art Independent Ruler, the Northern region. (The rest is identical with with the substitution of Maruts Soma. Nishkevalya Uktha. Vairaja Saman for the corresponding names).

verses.sa: अधिपत्न्यसि बृहती दिग्विश्वे ते देवा अधिपतयो बृहस्पतिर्हेतीनां प्रतिधर्ता त्रिणवत्रयस्त्रिंशौ त्वा स्तोमौ पृथिव्यां श्रयतां वैश्वदेवाग्निमारुते उक्थे अव्यथायै स्तभ्नीतां शाक्वररैवते सामनी प्रतिष्ठित्या अन्तरिक्ष ऋषयस्त्वा प्रथमजा देवेषु दिवो मात्रया वरिम्णा प्रथन्तु विधर्ता चायमधिपतिश्च ते त्वा सर्वे संविदाना नाकस्य पृष्ठे स्वर्गे लोके यजमानं च सादयन्तु॥
verses.tr: adhipatnyasi bṛhatī digviśve te devā adhipatayo bṛhaspatirhetīnāṃ pratidhartā triṇavatrayastriṃśau tvā stomau pṛthivyāṃ śrayatāṃ vaiśvadevāgnimārute ukthe avyathāyai stabhnītāṃ śākvararaivate sāmanī pratiṣṭhityā antarikṣa ṛṣayastvā prathamajā deveṣu divo mātrayā varimṇā prathantu vidhartā cāyamadhipatiśca te tvā sarve saṃvidānā nākasya pṛṣṭhe svarge loke yajamānaṃ ca sādayantu
verses.en: Thou art Lady-Paramount, the Lofty region. The rest as above, Visvedevas.Brihaspati and Trayastrimsa Somas. Vaisvadeva and Maruts Sakvara and Raivata Samans being substituted for the corresponding names.

verses.sa: अयं पुरो हरिकेशः सूर्यरश्मिस्तस्य रथगृत्सश्च रथौजाश्च सेनानीग्रामण्यौ। पुञ्जिकस्थला च क्रतुस्थला चाप्सरसौ दङ्क्ष्णवः पशवो हेतिः पौरुषेयो वधः प्रहेतिस्तेभ्यो नमो अस्तु ते नोऽवन्तु ते नो मृडयन्तु ते यं द्विष्मो यश्च नो द्वेष्टि तमेषां जम्भे दध्मः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ puro harikeśaḥ sūryaraśmistasya rathagṛtsaśca rathaujāśca senānīgrāmaṇyau puñjikasthalā ca kratusthalā cāpsarasau daṅkṣṇavaḥ paśavo hetiḥ pauruṣeyo vadhaḥ prahetistebhyo namo astu te no'vantu te no mṛḍayantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ
verses.en: This one in front, golden-tressed, with sunbeams; the leader of his host and his chieftain are Rathagritsa and Rathaujas, and Punjikasthala and Kratusthala his Apsarases. Biting animals are his weapon, homicide his missile weapon; to them be homage: may they protect us, may they have mercy upon us. In their jaws we place the man whom we hate and who hates us.

verses.sa: अयं दक्षिणा विश्वकर्मा तस्य रथस्वनश्च रथेचित्रश्च सेनानीग्रामण्यौ। मेनका च सहजन्या चाप्सरसौ यातुधाना हेती रक्षांसि प्रहेतिस्तेभ्यो नमो अस्तु ते नोऽवन्तु ते नो मृडयन्तु ते यं द्विष्मो यश्च नो द्वेष्टि तमेषां जम्भे दध्मः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ dakṣiṇā viśvakarmā tasya rathasvanaśca rathecitraśca senānīgrāmaṇyau menakā ca sahajanyā cāpsarasau yātudhānā hetī rakṣāṃsi prahetistebhyo namo astu te no'vantu te no mṛḍayantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ
verses.en: This one on the right, the Visvakarman; the leader of his host and his chieftain are Ahavaniya and Batheehitra, and Menaka and Sahajanya his Apsarases. Yatudhanas are his weapon, Rakshasas his missile weapon; to them be homage, etc. (as in).

verses.sa: अयं पश्चाद्विश्वव्यचास्तस्य रथप्रोतश्चासमरथश्च सेनानीग्रामण्यौ। प्रम्लोचन्ती चानुम्लोचन्ती चाप्सरसौ व्याघ्रा हेतिः सर्पाः प्रहेतिस्तेभ्यो नमो अस्तु ते नोऽवन्तु ते नो मृडयन्तु ते यं द्विष्मो यश्च नो द्वेष्टि तमेषां जम्भे दध्मः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ paścādviśvavyacāstasya rathaprotaścāsamarathaśca senānīgrāmaṇyau pramlocantī cānumlocantī cāpsarasau vyāghrā hetiḥ sarpāḥ prahetistebhyo namo astu te no'vantu te no mṛḍayantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ
verses.en: This one behind, the All-comprising; the leader of his host and his chieftain are Rathaprota and Asamaratha, and Pramlochanti! and Anumlochanti are his Apsarases. Tigers are his weapon. Serpents his missile weapon; to them be homage, etc.

verses.sa: अयमुत्तरात्संयद्वसुस्तस्य तार्क्ष्यश्चारिष्टनेमिश्च सेनानीग्रामण्यौ। विश्वाची च घृताची चाप्सरसावापो हेतिर्वातः प्रहेतिस्तेभ्यो नमो अस्तु ते नोऽवन्तु ते नो मृडयन्तु ते यं द्विष्मो यश्च नो द्वेष्टि तमेषां जम्भे दध्मः॥
verses.tr: ayamuttarātsaṃyadvasustasya tārkṣyaścāriṣṭanemiśca senānīgrāmaṇyau viśvācī ca ghṛtācī cāpsarasāvāpo hetirvātaḥ prahetistebhyo namo astu te no'vantu te no mṛḍayantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ
verses.en: This one on the left, Lord of uninterrupted riches; the leader of his host and his chieftain are Tarkshya and Arishtanemi, and Visvachi and Ghritachi his Apsarases. Water is his weapon, wind his missile weapon; to them be homage, etc.

verses.sa: अयमुपर्यर्वाग्वसुस्तस्य सेनजिच्च सुषेणश्च सेनानीग्रामण्यौ। उर्वशी च पूर्वचित्तिश्चाप्सरसावबस्फूर्जन् हेतिर्विद्युत्प्रहेतिस्तेभ्यो नमो अस्तु ते नोऽवन्तु ते नो मृडयन्तु ते यं द्विष्मो यश्च नो द्वेष्टि तमेषां जम्भे दध्मः॥
verses.tr: ayamuparyarvāgvasustasya senajicca suṣeṇaśca senānīgrāmaṇyau urvaśī ca pūrvacittiścāpsarasāvabasphūrjan hetirvidyutprahetistebhyo namo astu te no'vantu te no mṛḍayantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ
verses.en: This one above, Wealth-giver; the leader of his host and his chieftain are Senajit and Sushena, and Urvasi and Purvachitti his Apsarases. Thundering is his weapon and lightning his missile weapon; to them be homage, etc.

verses.sa: अग्निर्मूर्धा दिवः ककुत्पतिः पृथिव्या अयम्। अपां रेतांसि जिन्वति॥
verses.tr: agnirmūrdhā divaḥ kakutpatiḥ pṛthivyā ayam apāṃ retāṃsi jinvati
verses.en: Agni is head and height of heaven, the Master of the earth is he. He quickeneth the waters' seed.

verses.sa: अयमग्निः सहस्रिणो वाजस्य शतिनस्पतिः। मूर्धा कवी रयीणाम्॥
verses.tr: ayamagniḥ sahasriṇo vājasya śatinaspatiḥ mūrdhā kavī rayīṇām
verses.en: This Agni is the Master of spoil thousandfold and hundredfold; the sapient one, the head of wealth.

verses.sa: त्वामग्ने पुष्करादध्यथर्वा निरमन्थत। मूर्ध्नो विश्वस्य वाघतः॥
verses.tr: tvāmagne puṣkarādadhyatharvā niramanthata mūrdhno viśvasya vāghataḥ
verses.en: Agni, Atharvan brought thee forth by rubbing from the

verses.sa: भुवो यज्ञस्य रजसश्च नेता यत्रा नियुद्भिः सचसे शिवाभिः। दिवि मूर्धानं दधिषे स्वर्षां जिह्वामग्ने चकृषे हव्यवाहम्॥
verses.tr: bhuvo yajñasya rajasaśca netā yatrā niyudbhiḥ sacase śivābhiḥ divi mūrdhānaṃ dadhiṣe svarṣāṃ jihvāmagne cakṛṣe havyavāham
verses.en: Guide of the rite art thou and of the region to which with thine auspicious teams thou tendest. Thy light-bestowing head to heaven thou liftest, making thy tongue oblation-bearer, Agni.

verses.sa: अबोध्यग्निः समिधा जनानां प्रति धेनुमिवायतीमुषासम्। यह्वा इव प्र वयामुज्जिहानाः प्र भानवः सिस्रते नाकमच्छ॥
verses.tr: abodhyagniḥ samidhā janānāṃ prati dhenumivāyatīmuṣāsam yahvā iva pra vayāmujjihānāḥ pra bhānavaḥ sisrate nākamaccha
verses.en: Agni is wakened by the people's fuel to meet the Dawn who; cometh like a milch-cow. Like young trees shooting up on high their branches his flames are rising to the vault of heaven.

verses.sa: अवोचाम कवये मेध्याय वचो वन्दारु वृषभाय वृष्णे। गविष्ठिरो नमसा स्तोममग्नौ दिवीव रुक्ममुरुव्यञ्चमश्रेत्॥
verses.tr: avocāma kavaye medhyāya vaco vandāru vṛṣabhāya vṛṣṇe gaviṣṭhiro namasā stomamagnau divīva rukmamuruvyañcamaśret
verses.en: To him adorable, sage, strong and mighty we have sung; forth our song of praise and homage. Gavishthira hath raised with prayer to Agni this laud far-reaching as the gold in heaven.

verses.sa: अयमिह प्रथमो धायि धातृभिर्होता यजिष्ठो अध्वरेष्वीड्यः। यमप्नवानो भृगवो विरुरुचुर्वनेषु चित्रं विभ्वं विशे-विशे॥
verses.tr: ayamiha prathamo dhāyi dhātṛbhirhotā yajiṣṭho adhvareṣvīḍyaḥ yamapnavāno bhṛgavo virurucurvaneṣu citraṃ vibhvaṃ viśe-viśe
verses.en: Here by ordainers was this God appointed first Invoker, best at worship, to be praised at rites; Whom Apnavana and the Bhrigus caused to shine bright-coloured in the wood, spreading to every house.,.

verses.sa: जनस्य गोपा अजनिष्ट जागृविरग्निः सुदक्षः सुविताय नव्यसे। घृतप्रतीको बृहता दिविस्पृशा द्युमद्वि भाति भरतेभ्यः शुचिः॥
verses.tr: janasya gopā ajaniṣṭa jāgṛviragniḥ sudakṣaḥ suvitāya navyase ghṛtapratīko bṛhatā divispṛśā dyumadvi bhāti bharatebhyaḥ śuciḥ
verses.en: The watchful Guardian of the people hath been born, Agni the very strong, for fresh prosperity. With oil upon his face, with high heaven-touching flame, he shineth splendidly, pure for the Bharatas.

verses.sa: त्वामग्ने अङ्गिरसो गुहा हितमन्वविन्दञ्छिश्रियाणं वने-वने। स जायसे मथ्यमानः सहो महत्त्वामाहुः सहसस्पुत्रमङ्गिरः॥
verses.tr: tvāmagne aṅgiraso guhā hitamanvavindañchiśriyāṇaṃ vane-vane sa jāyase mathyamānaḥ saho mahattvāmāhuḥ sahasasputramaṅgiraḥ
verses.en: Agni, Angirases discovered thee what time thou layest hidden fleeing back from wood to wood. Thou by attrition art produced as conquering might, and men, O Angiras, call thee the Son of Strength.

verses.sa: सखायः सं वः सम्यञ्चमिषं स्तोमं चाग्नये। वर्षिष्ठाय क्षितीनामूर्जो नप्त्रे सहस्वते॥
verses.tr: sakhāyaḥ saṃ vaḥ samyañcamiṣaṃ stomaṃ cāgnaye varṣiṣṭhāya kṣitīnāmūrjo naptre sahasvate
verses.en: Offer to Agni, O my friends, your seemly food, your seemly praise; To him supremest o'er the folk, the Son of Strength, the Mighty Lord.

verses.sa: संसमिद्युवसे वृषन्नग्ने विश्वान्यर्य आ। इडस्पदे समिध्यसे स नो वसून्या भर॥
verses.tr: saṃsamidyuvase vṛṣannagne viśvānyarya ā iḍaspade samidhyase sa no vasūnyā bhara
verses.en: Thou, mighty Agni, gatherest up all that is precious for thy friend. Bring us all treasure as thou art enkindled in libation's place.-

verses.sa: त्वां चित्रश्रवस्तम हवन्ते विक्षु जन्तवः। शोचिष्केशं पुरुप्रियाग्ने हव्याय वोढवे॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ citraśravastama havante vikṣu jantavaḥ śociṣkeśaṃ purupriyāgne havyāya voḍhave
verses.en: O Agni, loved of many, thou of fame most wondrous, in their homes Men call on thee whose hair is flame to be the bearer of their gifts.

verses.sa: एना वो अग्निं नमसोर्जो नपातमा हुवे। प्रियं चेतिष्ठमरतिं स्वध्वरं विश्वस्य दूतममृतम्॥
verses.tr: enā vo agniṃ namasorjo napātamā huve priyaṃ cetiṣṭhamaratiṃ svadhvaraṃ viśvasya dūtamamṛtam
verses.en: With this my reverent hymn I call Agni for you, the Sod of Strength, Dear, wisest envoy, served with noble sacrifice, inunortal messenger of all.

verses.sa: विश्वस्य दूतममृतं विश्वस्य दूतममृतम्। स योजते अरुषा विश्वभोजसा स दुद्रवत्स्वाहुतः॥
verses.tr: viśvasya dūtamamṛtaṃ viśvasya dūtamamṛtam sa yojate aruṣā viśvabhojasā sa dudravatsvāhutaḥ
verses.en: Immortal messenger of all, immortal messenger of all, {113 His two red steeds, all-cherishing, he harnesseth; let him, well-worshipped, urge them fast.

verses.sa: स दुद्रवत्स्वाहुतः स दुद्रवत्स्वाहुतः। सुब्रह्मा यज्ञः सुशमी वसूनां देवं राधो जनानाम्॥
verses.tr: sa dudravatsvāhutaḥ sa dudravatsvāhutaḥ subrahmā yajñaḥ suśamī vasūnāṃ devaṃ rādho janānām
verses.en: Let him well-worshipped urge them fast, let him well worshipped urge them fast. Then hath the sacrifice good prayer and happy end, and heavenly gift of wealth to men.

verses.sa: अग्ने वाजस्य गोमत ईशानः सहसो यहो। अस्मे धेहि जातवेदो महि श्रवः॥
verses.tr: agne vājasya gomata īśānaḥ sahaso yaho asme dhehi jātavedo mahi śravaḥ
verses.en: O Agni, thou who art the Lord of wealth in kine, the Son of Strength, Vouchsafe to us, O Jatavedas, high renown.

verses.sa: स इधानो वसुष्कविरग्निरीडेन्यो गिरा। रेवदस्मभ्यं पुर्वणीक दीदिहि॥
verses.tr: sa idhāno vasuṣkaviragnirīḍenyo girā revadasmabhyaṃ purvaṇīka dīdihi
verses.en: He, Agni, kindled, good and wise, must be exalted in our song: Shine, thou of many forms, shine radiantly on us.

verses.sa: क्षपो राजन्नुत त्मनाग्ने वस्तोरुतोषसः। स तिग्मजम्भ रक्षसो दह प्रति॥
verses.tr: kṣapo rājannuta tmanāgne vastorutoṣasaḥ sa tigmajambha rakṣaso daha prati
verses.en: O Agni, shining of thyself by night and when the morning breaks. Burn, thou whose teeth are sharp, against the Rakshasas.

verses.sa: भद्रो नो अग्निराहुतो भद्रा रातिः सुभग भद्रो अध्वरः। भद्रा उत प्रशस्तयः॥
verses.tr: bhadro no agnirāhuto bhadrā rātiḥ subhaga bhadro adhvaraḥ bhadrā uta praśastayaḥ
verses.en: May Agni, worshipped, bring us bliss, may the gift, Blessed One! And sacrifice bring bliss. Yea, may oar praises bring us bliss.

verses.sa: भद्रा उत प्रशस्तयो भद्रं मनः कृणुष्व वृत्रतूर्ये। येना समत्सु सासहः॥
verses.tr: bhadrā uta praśastayo bhadraṃ manaḥ kṛṇuṣva vṛtratūrye yenā samatsu sāsahaḥ
verses.en: Yea, may our praises bring us bliss. Yea, may our praises bring ns bliss. Show forth the mind that brings success in war with fiends, wherewith thou conquerest in fights:

verses.sa: येना समत्सु सासहोऽव स्थिरा तनुहि भूरि शर्धताम्। वनेमा ते अभिष्टिभिः॥
verses.tr: yenā samatsu sāsaho'va sthirā tanuhi bhūri śardhatām vanemā te abhiṣṭibhiḥ
verses.en: Wherewith thou conquerest in fights. Bring down the many firm hopes of our enemies, and let us vanquish with thine aid.

verses.sa: अग्निं तं मन्ये यो वसुरस्तं यं यन्ति धेनवः। अस्तमर्वन्त आशवोऽस्तं नित्यासो वाजिन इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर॥
verses.tr: agniṃ taṃ manye yo vasurastaṃ yaṃ yanti dhenavaḥ astamarvanta āśavo'staṃ nityāso vājina iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara
verses.en: I value Agni, that good Lord, the home to which the kine return; Whom fleet-foot coursers seek as home, and strong enduring steeds as home. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

verses.sa: सो अग्निर्यो वसुर्गृणे सं यमायन्ति धेनवः। समर्वन्तो रघुद्रुवः सं सुजातासः सूरय इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर॥
verses.tr: so agniryo vasurgṛṇe saṃ yamāyanti dhenavaḥ samarvanto raghudruvaḥ saṃ sujātāsaḥ sūraya iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara
verses.en: Tis Agni whom we laud as good, to whom the milch-kine come in herds, To whom the coursers swift of foot, to whom our well-born princes come. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

verses.sa: उभे सुश्चन्द्र सर्पिषो दर्वी श्रीणीष आसनि। उतो न उत्पुपूर्या उक्थेषु शवसस्पत इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर॥
verses.tr: ubhe suścandra sarpiṣo darvī śrīṇīṣa āsani uto na utpupūryā uktheṣu śavasaspata iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara
verses.en: Thou, brilliant God, within thy> mouth warmest both ladles of the oil. So fill us also in our hymns abundantly, O Lord of Strength. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

verses.sa: अग्ने तमद्याश्वं न स्तोमैः क्रतुं न भद्रं हृदिस्पृशम्। ऋध्यामा त ओहैः॥
verses.tr: agne tamadyāśvaṃ na stomaiḥ kratuṃ na bhadraṃ hṛdispṛśam ṛdhyāmā ta ohaiḥ
verses.en: Agni, with lauds this day may we bring thee that which thou lovest. Right judgment, like a horse, with our devotions.

verses.sa: अधा ह्यग्ने क्रतोर्भद्रस्य दक्षस्य साधोः। रथीरृतस्य बृहतो बभूथ॥
verses.tr: adhā hyagne kratorbhadrasya dakṣasya sādhoḥ rathīrṛtasya bṛhato babhūtha
verses.en: For thou hast ever been the car-driver, Agni, of noble Strength, lofty sacrifice, and rightful judgment.

verses.sa: एभिर्नो अर्कैर्भवा नो अर्वाङ् स्वर्ण ज्योतिः। अग्ने विश्वेभिः सुमना अनीकैः॥
verses.tr: ebhirno arkairbhavā no arvāṅ svarṇa jyotiḥ agne viśvebhiḥ sumanā anīkaiḥ
verses.en: Through these our praises come thou to meet us, bright as the sunlight, O Agni, well-disposed, with all thine aspects.

verses.sa: अग्निं होतारं मन्ये दास्वन्तं वसुं सूनुं सहसो जातवेदसं विप्रं न जातवेदसम्। य ऊर्ध्वया स्वध्वरो देवो देवाच्या कृपा। घृतस्य विभ्राष्टिमनु वष्टि शोचिषाऽऽजुह्वानस्य सर्पिषः॥
verses.tr: agniṃ hotāraṃ manye dāsvantaṃ vasuṃ sūnuṃ sahaso jātavedasaṃ vipraṃ na jātavedasam ya ūrdhvayā svadhvaro devo devācyā kṛpā ghṛtasya vibhrāṣṭimanu vaṣṭi śociṣā''juhvānasya sarpiṣaḥ
verses.en: Agni I hold as Herald, the munificent, the gracious Son of Strength who knoweth all that live, as: holy singer knowing all; Lord of fair rites, a God with form erected, turning to the Gods, He, when the flame hath sprung forth from the sacred oil, the offered fatness, longeth for it with his glow.

verses.sa: अग्ने त्वं नो अन्तम उत त्राता शिवो भव वरूथ्यः। वसुरग्निर्वसुश्रवा अच्छा नक्षि द्युमत्तमं रयिं दाः। तं त्वा शोचिष्ठ दीदिवः सुम्नाय नूनमीमहे सखिभ्यः॥
verses.tr: agne tvaṃ no antama uta trātā śivo bhava varūthyaḥ vasuragnirvasuśravā acchā nakṣi dyumattamaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ taṃ tvā śociṣṭha dīdivaḥ sumnāya nūnamīmahe sakhibhyaḥ
verses.en: O Agni, be our nearest Friend, be thou a kind deliverer and a gracious Friend. Come as good Agni, come as excellent and give us wealth most splendidly renowned. To thee then, O most bright, O radiant God, we come with prayer for happiness for our friends.

verses.sa: येन ऋषयस्तपसा सत्रमायन्निन्धाना अग्निं स्वराभरन्तः। तस्मिन्नहं नि दधे नाके अग्निं यमाहुर्मनव स्तीर्णबर्हिषम्॥
verses.tr: yena ṛṣayastapasā satramāyannindhānā agniṃ svarābharantaḥ tasminnahaṃ ni dadhe nāke agniṃ yamāhurmanava stīrṇabarhiṣam
verses.en: With wHat devotion, winning light, the Rishis came, kindling Agni, to the holy session, Even with that in heaven I stablish Agni whom men call him whose sacred grass is scattered.

verses.sa: तं पत्नीभिरनु गच्छेम देवाः पुत्रैर्भ्रातृभिरुत वा हिरण्यैः। नाकं गृभ्णानाः सुकृतस्य लोके तृतीये पृष्ठे अधि रोचने दिवः॥
verses.tr: taṃ patnībhiranu gacchema devāḥ putrairbhrātṛbhiruta vā hiraṇyaiḥ nākaṃ gṛbhṇānāḥ sukṛtasya loke tṛtīye pṛṣṭhe adhi rocane divaḥ
verses.en: Gods, let us follow him with wives beside us, with sons, with brothers, with our gold adornments, Grasping the sky up in the world of virtue, on the third height, the luminous realm of heaven.

verses.sa: आ वाचो मध्यमरुहद्भुरण्युरयमग्निः सत्पतिश्चेकितानः। पृष्ठे पृथिव्या निहितो दविद्युतदधस्पदं कृणुतां ये पृतन्यवः॥
verses.tr: ā vāco madhyamaruhadbhuraṇyurayamagniḥ satpatiścekitānaḥ pṛṣṭhe pṛthivyā nihito davidyutadadhaspadaṃ kṛṇutāṃ ye pṛtanyavaḥ
verses.en: This Agni mounted up to Speech's Centre, Lord of the Brave, observant, ever-active. Laid on the back of Earth, may he, resplendent, cast under foot those who would fight against us.

verses.sa: अयमग्निर्वीरतमो वयोधाः सहस्रियो द्योततामप्रयुच्छन्। विभ्राजमानः सरिरस्य मध्य उप प्र याहि दिव्यानि धाम॥
verses.tr: ayamagnirvīratamo vayodhāḥ sahasriyo dyotatāmaprayucchan vibhrājamānaḥ sarirasya madhya upa pra yāhi divyāni dhāma
verses.en: May this most manly Agni, strength-bestower, giver of thousands, shine with care that fails not. Resplendent in the middle of the water, make thine approach to the celestial mansions.

verses.sa: सम्प्रच्यवध्वमुप सम्प्रयाताग्ने पथो देवयानान् कृणुध्वम्। पुनः कृण्वाना पितरा युवानाऽन्वातांसीत् त्वयि तन्तुमेतम्॥
verses.tr: sampracyavadhvamupa samprayātāgne patho devayānān kṛṇudhvam punaḥ kṛṇvānā pitarā yuvānā'nvātāṃsīt tvayi tantumetam
verses.en: Make him go forth from all sides: meet, approach ye. O Agni, make the patha for God ward travel. Making the Parents young with life's renewal, the out-spun thread in thee have they extended.

verses.sa: उद्बुध्यस्वाग्ने प्रति जागृहि त्वमिष्टापूर्ते सं सृजेथामयं च। अस्मिन्त्सधस्थे अध्युत्तरस्मिन् विस्वे देवा यजमानाश्च सीदत॥
verses.tr: udbudhyasvāgne prati jāgṛhi tvamiṣṭāpūrte saṃ sṛjethāmayaṃ ca asmintsadhasthe adhyuttarasmin visve devā yajamānāśca sīdata
verses.en: Wake up, O Agni, thou, and keep him watchful. Wish and fruition, meet, and he, together. In this and in the loftier habitation be seated, All-Gods! and the Sacrificer.

verses.sa: येन वहसि सहस्रं येनाग्ने सर्ववेदसम्। तेनेमं यज्ञं नो नय स्वर्देवेषु गन्तवे॥
verses.tr: yena vahasi sahasraṃ yenāgne sarvavedasam tenemaṃ yajñaṃ no naya svardeveṣu gantave
verses.en: Convey our sacrifice to heaven that it may reach the Gods, with that. Whereby, thou, Agni, bearest wealth in thousands and all precious things.

verses.sa: अयं ते योनिरृत्वियो यतो जातो अरोचथा। तं जानन्नग्न आ रोहाथा नो वर्धया रयिम्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ te yonirṛtviyo yato jāto arocathā taṃ jānannagna ā rohāthā no vardhayā rayim
verses.en: This is thine ordered place of birth whence sprung to life thou shonest forth. Knowing this, Agni, rise thou up and cause our riches to increase.

verses.sa: तपश्च तपस्यश्च शैशिरावृतू अग्नेरन्तः श्लेषोऽसि कल्पेतां द्यावापृथिवी कल्पन्तामाप ओषधयः कल्पन्तामग्नयः पृथङ्मम ज्यैष्ठ्याय सव्रताः। ये अग्नयः समनसोऽन्तरा द्यावापृथिवी इमे। शैशिरावृतू अभिकल्पमाना इन्द्रमिव देवा अभिसंविशन्तु तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद्ध्रुवे सीदतम्॥
verses.tr: tapaśca tapasyaśca śaiśirāvṛtū agnerantaḥ śleṣo'si kalpetāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī kalpantāmāpa oṣadhayaḥ kalpantāmagnayaḥ pṛthaṅmama jyaiṣṭhyāya savratāḥ ye agnayaḥ samanaso'ntarā dyāvāpṛthivī ime śaiśirāvṛtū abhikalpamānā indramiva devā abhisaṃviśantu tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvaddhruve sīdatam
verses.en: Tapas, Tapasya, pair of Dewy Seasons: thou art, etc. as in XIIl. 25.

verses.sa: परमेष्ठी त्वा सादयतु दिवस्पृष्ठे ज्योतिष्मतीम्। विश्वस्मै प्राणायापानाय व्यानाय विश्वं ज्योतिर्यच्छ। सूर्यस्तेऽधिपतिस्तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवा सीद॥
verses.tr: parameṣṭhī tvā sādayatu divaspṛṣṭhe jyotiṣmatīm viśvasmai prāṇāyāpānāya vyānāya viśvaṃ jyotiryaccha sūryaste'dhipatistayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda
verses.en: On the sky's back may Parameshthin lay thee, etc. as in Thy Lord is Surya, etc. as in XIV. 14.

verses.sa: लोकं पृण छिद्रं पृणाथो सीद ध्रुवा त्वम्। इन्द्राग्नी त्वा बृहस्पतिरस्मिन्योनावसीषदन्॥
verses.tr: lokaṃ pṛṇa chidraṃ pṛṇātho sīda dhruvā tvam indrāgnī tvā bṛhaspatirasminyonāvasīṣadan
verses.en: Repeated from XII. 54.

verses.sa: ता अस्य सूददोहसः सोमं श्रीणन्ति पृश्नयः। जन्मन्देवानां विशस्त्रिष्वा रोचने दिवः॥
verses.tr: tā asya sūdadohasaḥ somaṃ śrīṇanti pṛśnayaḥ janmandevānāṃ viśastriṣvā rocane divaḥ
verses.en: Repeated from XII. 55.

verses.sa: इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन्त्समुद्रव्यचसं गिरः। रथीतमं रथीनां वाजानां सत्पतिं पतिम्॥
verses.tr: indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhantsamudravyacasaṃ giraḥ rathītamaṃ rathīnāṃ vājānāṃ satpatiṃ patim
verses.en: Repeated from XII. 56.

verses.sa: प्रोथदश्वो न यवसेऽविष्यन्यदा महः संवरणाद्वयस्थात्। आदस्य वातो अनुवाति शोचिरध स्म ते व्रजनं कृष्णमस्ति॥
verses.tr: prothadaśvo na yavase'viṣyanyadā mahaḥ saṃvaraṇādvayasthāt ādasya vāto anuvāti śociradha sma te vrajanaṃ kṛṣṇamasti
verses.en: Like a horse neighing, eager for the pasture, when he hath stepped forth from the great enclosure: Then the wind following blows upon his splendour, and, straight, the path is black which thou hast travelled.

verses.sa: आयोष्ट्वा सदने सादयाम्यवतश्छायायां समुद्रस्य हृदये। रश्मीवतीं भास्वतीमा या द्यां भास्यापृथिवीमोर्वन्तरिक्षम्॥
verses.tr: āyoṣṭvā sadane sādayāmyavataśchāyāyāṃ samudrasya hṛdaye raśmīvatīṃ bhāsvatīmā yā dyāṃ bhāsyāpṛthivīmorvantarikṣam
verses.en: In Ayu's seat I set thee, in the shadow of the protector in the heart of Ocean, Thee luminous, bright with eyes, thee who illumest the sky, the earth, and air's broad realm between them.

verses.sa: परमेष्ठी त्वा सादयतु दिवस्पृष्ठे व्यचस्वतीं प्रथस्वतीं दिवं यच्छ दिवं दृंह दिवं मा हिंसीः। विश्वस्मै प्राणायापानाय व्यानायोदानाय प्रतिष्ठायै चरित्राय। सूर्यस्त्वाऽभि पातु मह्या स्वस्त्या छर्दिषा शन्तमेन तया देवतयाऽङ्गिरस्वद् ध्रुवे सीदतम्॥
verses.tr: parameṣṭhī tvā sādayatu divaspṛṣṭhe vyacasvatīṃ prathasvatīṃ divaṃ yaccha divaṃ dṛṃha divaṃ mā hiṃsīḥ viśvasmai prāṇāyāpānāya vyānāyodānāya pratiṣṭhāyai caritrāya sūryastvā'bhi pātu mahyā svastyā chardiṣā śantamena tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruve sīdatam
verses.en: On the sky's back may Parameshthin set thee, etc. (as in XIV. 12, substituting sky for air and Sarya for Vayu).

verses.sa: सहस्रस्य प्रमाऽसि सहस्रस्य प्रतिमाऽसि सहस्रस्योन्माऽसि साहस्रोऽसि सहस्राय त्वा॥
verses.tr: sahasrasya pramā'si sahasrasya pratimā'si sahasrasyonmā'si sāhasro'si sahasrāya tvā
verses.en: Thou art the measure of a thousand. Thou art the representative of a thousand. Thou art the equivalent of a thousand. Thou art worth a thousand. Thee for a thousand.
